text: “你投诉我也要找个18的
en: Even if you report me, I'd still want to find an 18-year-old.

text: 鄙人43，老婆41。
en: I am 43, my wife is 41.

text: 老婆常年健身，当然她建模不行，身高矮，除此之外脸型、身材比例都不错。
en: My wife works out all year round. Of course, she isn't much to look at and she's on the short side, but apart from that her face shape and body proportions are quite good.

text: 就这，我还愿意碰她，是因为家里饭吃着放心，完全不是因为她有姿色。
en: Even so, the reason I'm still willing to be intimate with her is that I can eat at home without a worry, and it's absolutely not because she's attractive.

text: 而到了外头，40岁的女人，相信我，年老色衰可能是你能接受的她们最小的弱点。
en: But out in the world, women of 40 — believe me — having lost their looks with age is likely the least of their flaws that you could accept.

text: 除非你本人建模特别好，否则，你搞定她们的代价高于20岁的小姑娘！
en: Unless you yourself are exceptionally good-looking, the cost of winning them over is higher than that of a 20-year-old girl!

text: 我自己身边82-87年的上海男人（市区郊区都有），37—42岁，未婚的还有不少。
en: Among the Shanghai men I know, born between 1982 and 1987 (both in the city centre and the suburbs), aged 37 to 42, quite a few are still unmarried.

text: 条件好的，找95后（上海苏南浙北，独生女）
en: Those in good circumstances find post-95 girls (Shanghai, southern Jiangsu, northern Zhejiang; only daughters).

text: 条件一般的，找90后（江浙沪皖，独生优先）
en: Those in average circumstances find post-90 girls (Jiangsu, Zhejiang, Shanghai, Anhui; only children prioritised).

text: 条件差的，找95后（经济欠发达地区，非独生）
en: Those in poor circumstances find post-95 girls (less developed regions; not only children).

text: 我目前还没听说过，84年男的会找84年女的，至少上海是这样子。
en: So far I haven't heard of an 84-born man seeking an 84-born woman; at least that is how it is in Shanghai.

text: 电影《霸道总裁爱上即将绝经的我》
en: The film *The Domineering CEO Falls for Menopausal Me*

text: 票房会有多少？
en: What would the box-office take be?

text: 我身边一个领导79年好多年前离婚无娃，今年想着还是再婚要个娃儿。
en: A boss I know, born in 1979, divorced many years ago with no children, thought this year he'd remarry and have a child.

text: 同事给他介绍的91年未婚，身体健康，身高偏矮些皮肤稍微黑一点，颜值算普通也愿意结婚生娃儿的女生，他看了一眼就说，也不是什么都要，好歹要睡得下嘛。
en: A colleague introduced him to an unmarried woman born in 1991, physically healthy, a bit on the short side with slightly darker skin; her looks were merely ordinary, but she was willing to marry and have children. He took one look and said, it's not that I want everything, but at least she should be someone I can sleep with.

text: 后面介绍个同龄的离异带娃的老师，颜值身材都还好。
en: Later they introduced a same-age divorced teacher with a child, whose looks and figure were both decent enough.

text: 立马屁颠屁颠约起，也不考虑能不能下崽儿的事了。
en: He eagerly set up a meeting straight away, and no longer bothered about whether she could bear children.

text: 40岁女颜值在线，你看是哪个考虑哪个？
en: A 40-year-old woman whose looks still hold up — which of the two do you think he'd go for?

text: 昨天遇见一个60岁的大哥，离异，所以最近疯狂相亲找女朋友。
en: Yesterday I met a 60-year-old chap, divorced, who has lately been frantically going on matchmaking dates to find a girlfriend.

text: 他最后挑来挑去的选了个32岁的。
en: After much picking and choosing, he finally settled on a 32-year-old.

text: 我们问他，这个年纪了不是应该找个年纪相仿的有共同语言吗？
en: We asked him, at this age shouldn't you find someone of a similar age, someone you share common ground with?

text: 他说，其实跟20多，30多，40多，甚至更大岁数的女人在一起将来的结局都是一样的，都不会太好，那不如找个年轻的，漂亮的，自己看着喜欢，高兴，整个人都觉得充满了活力，多好，有机会的话再生个孩子，感觉生命又重活一次，多好的。
en: He said, actually, being with a woman in her twenties, thirties, forties, or even older, the eventual outcome is all the same — none of it good. So why not find a younger, prettier one, someone you like to look at, who makes you happy and fills you with vitality again — how lovely — and if there's a chance, have another child and feel as though life is being lived all over again, how wonderful.

text: 我现在感觉自己状态非常年轻。
en: I now feel incredibly youthful.

text: 然后，在我们吃饭的间隙，他不停接他小女友的视频邀请，他都是跑的远远的。
en: Then, in the gaps between our meal, he kept taking his young girlfriend's video calls, always running off to some distant spot to do so.

text: 他的同班同学就一直给我吐槽，他说成天哄小孩有啥意思，这个年纪了就该跟原配一起相伴到老就是最好的。
en: His classmate kept grumbling to me, saying what's the point of pandering to a child all day; at this age you ought to grow old together with your first wife — that's the best there is.

text: 我看着他满头的白发，再看看他那个恋爱中的男同学一头黑发，似乎懂了一点。
en: I looked at his head of white hair, then at his lovesick male classmate's head of black hair, and felt I understood a little.

text: 前几年的时候，我老公做了一回媒人，很顺利的成功了。
en: A few years back, my husband played matchmaker once, and it went very smoothly.

text: 男方当时四十七岁，有个男孩国外留学正读大三，爱人猝然去世，我们两家关系很好，他爱人我也熟悉，噩耗传来痛哭了几场。
en: The man was then 47, with a son studying abroad in his third year of university; his wife had passed away suddenly. Our two families were close, and I knew his wife well; when the terrible news arrived I wept on several occasions.

text: 他们夫妻感情极好，同学时代走过来的。
en: The couple had been extremely close; they had come through their student days together.

text: 夫人过世不久就有人给介绍了，毕竟条件不错的，央企副总，稳定年入几十万，家里大平层别墅都有的，个子北方人180，长相一般也绝对不丑。
en: Not long after his wife passed, someone introduced him to a prospect, for his conditions were decent enough: a vice president at a central state-owned enterprise, a steady annual income of several hundred thousand, with both a large flat and a villa at home, a northerner standing 180cm tall, of average looks but certainly not ugly.

text: 不是秃头大肚子油腻男，情商能力都在线——当然这条件达不到小🍠和知乎人均百万收入的要求，我们三线城市，要求不高。
en: Not a balding, pot-bellied, greasy sort; his emotional intelligence and ability were both up to scratch — of course such conditions fall short of the per-capita-million-income standards of Xiaohongshu and Zhihu; we're a third-tier city, so our expectations aren't high.

text: 当时他拒绝考虑这个问题，亡妻尸骨未寒，走不出来。
en: At the time he refused even to consider the matter; his late wife's bones were not yet cold, and he could not move on.

text: 这样过了一年多，慢慢的开始有选择的去见人。
en: After more than a year like this, he gradually began to meet people on a selective basis.

text: 介绍的条件很好，有刚毕业新入职的小姑娘，也有离婚无孩的，有漂亮的也有一般的。
en: The introductions were of good quality: there were fresh graduates just starting work, as well as divorced women without children, pretty ones and plain ones.

text: 当然，都比他年轻多了。
en: Of course, they were all far younger than him.

text: 他态度是不拒绝，不积极，找到合适的就找，不合适单着也可以，所以有选择的去见。
en: His attitude was to neither refuse nor push: if he found a suitable one he'd go for it, and if not he was happy to stay single, so he met people selectively.

text: 一个系统的他都pass，主动往上扑的更不可能。
en: He passed on all those from the same system; those who threw themselves at him were even more out of the question.

text: 毕竟要注意影响的，人家图啥他心知肚明。
en: After all, he had to mind his reputation; what they were after he knew full well.

text: 年轻的也pass，他们上班搞业绩开会各种关系应酬要累死了，没精力再哄小姑娘提供情绪价值那一套。
en: The young ones he passed on too; they were at work chasing targets, in meetings, and worn out juggling all sorts of networking and social obligations — with no energy left to pamper some young girl and play that emotional-value game.

text: 都有代沟了，共同语言基本没有。
en: There was already a generation gap, and basically no common ground.

text: 小姑娘提供的激情和肉体，敬谢不敏，不是所有男人脑子都在下半部的。
en: The passion and physical intimacy offered by young girls — he politely declined; not every man has his brains below the waist.

text: 离婚有娃的pass，男娃女娃都不行，带不带都不行，他自己的孩子毕业已经独立了，不想再操心别人的事。
en: Divorced women with children he passed on — whether a boy or a girl, whether she had custody or not, none would do; his own child had graduated and become independent, and he didn't want to fret over someone else's affairs again.

text: 关系复杂懒得处理。
en: The relationships were too tangled to bother dealing with.

text: 太漂亮的不见，自持美貌的更加pass，他说配不上人家。
en: The very beautiful ones he wouldn't meet; those who traded on their looks he passed on all the more, saying he wasn't worthy of them.

text: 这种情况下，我老公的同学找来了，这同学介绍她的同事，gwy，比男方小五岁，未婚，长相一般，有点书生气，年轻时恋爱过没结果，蹉跎下来一直单身，独生女，自己有车有房，父母县城有退休金。
en: In this situation, a classmate of my husband's came forward, and this classmate introduced a colleague of hers, a civil servant, five years younger than the man, unmarried, of average looks, with a somewhat bookish air; she had been in love when young but it came to nothing, and had drifted along single ever since — an only daughter, with her own car and flat, her parents drawing a pension in a county town.

text: 俩人相见后都有好感，处了一年左右，现在已经结婚了（多说一句，婚礼他没大办，但是我我也没参加，想起他亡妻实在是难过）。
en: After they met, both took a liking to each other, and after about a year of seeing one another they are now married (one more thing: he didn't hold a grand wedding, and I myself didn't attend either, for the thought of his late wife was simply too painful).

text: 婚前，男方把自己名下的房子给孩子两套，一套市中心大平层，一套小别墅——都卖了，后来孩子在杭州工作，买了那边的房子。
en: Before the marriage, the man gave two of the flats under his name to his child: one a large city-centre flat, one a small villa — both were sold; later the child worked in Hangzhou and bought a flat there.

text: 存款啥的也做好隔离——孩子母亲那份以后都给孩子，他自己的一半也以后也会给孩子（他说的，全家财产的一半算亡妻的，给孩子；另一半是他的，他从这分一半给孩子。
en: Savings and such were also properly ring-fenced — the portion that belonged to the child's mother would later all go to the child, and his own half would also later go to the child (as he put it: half of the family's assets counted as the late wife's, to the child; the other half was his, and from that he would give half to the child.

text: 另外，他收入是新娶妻子的大概四到五倍，婚后收入归新家庭，婚后他购买的房子俩人名字。
en: Additionally, his income is roughly four to five times that of his new wife; their post-marriage income goes to the new family, and the flat he bought after the marriage is in both their names.

text: 婚后，买了新房子，依然是大平层（惭愧，我说错了，140平米不算大平层，被嘲笑～但就此说明不改了）。
en: After the marriage they bought a new flat, still a large flat (I'm embarrassed to admit I was wrong — 140 square metres doesn't count as a large flat, and I got teased about it ~ but I'll leave it as it is).

text: 我们三线小城市，房价和省会及一线城市比不了 ，大家原谅我没见识。
en: We're a small third-tier city; our house prices can't compare with those of the provincial capital and first-tier cities, so please forgive my lack of worldly experience.

text: 因为尊重新婚妻子，他是卖了一套房子又加了点钱换的这套，
en: Out of respect for his new wife, he sold one flat and added some money to trade up to this one,

text: 俩人安安静静的过着日子，老夫老妻一样。
en: The two of them live quietly, like an old married couple.

text: 年龄相差五岁，都是七零后。
en: They are five years apart in age, both of the post-70s generation.

text: 他爱做饭，平时俩人吃食堂只有晚饭能一起吃，只要在家都是他下厨。
en: He loves to cook; normally they eat in the canteen and can only have dinner together, but whenever they're at home he is the one who cooks.

text: 新娶的妻子想要孩子，他不反对也配合，但是私下里跟我们说是不想要的，随缘吧，目前是没有，应该也不会有了，五十多岁了。
en: His new wife wants a child; he doesn't object and goes along with it, but in private he told us he doesn't actually want one — leave it to fate, he said; there isn't one at present and probably won't be, as he's already in his fifties.

text: 我周围的人离婚的不多，再婚找的基本相差五六岁没超过十岁的。
en: Among the people around me, not many are divorced; those who remarry generally find someone five or six years apart, not exceeding ten.

text: 大家都是普通人，互相所图基本都能看出来，有些东西是不值得用婚姻交换的，安稳生活才是真正需要的。
en: We're all ordinary people; what each side is after is plainly visible, and some things aren't worth trading for in marriage — a stable life is what's truly needed.

text: 刚说过周围离婚人不多，想想参加工作三十多年，同学同事朋友认识的人，也有五六个离婚的。
en: I just said few around me are divorced, but thinking back over more than thirty years of work, among the classmates, colleagues and friends I know, there are also five or six who divorced.

text: 还有一对，依然是再婚夫妻相差五岁的。
en: There is another couple, also a remarried pair five years apart.

text: 男，再婚时41岁，我们市这边央企副总，现在已经退休，退休前做到了省副总。
en: The man, when he remarried, was 41, a vice president at a central state-owned enterprise in our city; now retired, he had before retirement risen to provincial vice president.

text: 收入同上（我老公的同事们，熟悉的过来过去就是这些人），后来更高。
en: His income was as above (my husband's colleagues — the familiar faces coming and going are just these people), and later it was even higher.

text: 长得特别有男人味，高大魁梧，作风硬朗，讲义气，我总联想到乔峰。
en: He looked especially masculine, tall and burly, with a brisk, decisive style and a loyal streak; I always think of Qiao Feng.

text: 他是离异，前妻也是女强人，俩人同系统级别差不多，都是强势的性格，工作原因聚少离多，有个儿子，离婚时初中，后来国外留学，现在拿了身份不回来了。
en: He was divorced; his ex-wife was also a strong, capable woman. The two were in the same system with similar ranks, both strong-willed; work kept them apart much of the time, and they had a son who was in junior high when they divorced, later studied abroad, and now has obtained residency and won't come back.

text: 夫妻俩也算好聚好散吧，内情不知道，总之离婚也没啥流言。
en: The couple parted on reasonably amicable terms, I don't know the inside story, but in any case the divorce gave rise to no real gossip.

text: 儿子归他，具体家产怎么分不清楚。
en: The son stayed with him; exactly how the assets were divided isn't clear.

text: 离婚后三年经介绍认识的女方。
en: The woman he met through an introduction three years after the divorce.

text: 女方再婚时36，离异，跟前夫没孩子。
en: The woman, when she remarried, was 36, divorced, with no children by her ex-husband.

text: 不是同系统，算关联单位吧，一般工作人员。
en: Not the same system, but an affiliated unit — a regular member of staff.

text: 长得非常漂亮，一米七多的个子，身材玲珑有致，也会爱打扮，现在五十多了风韵犹存。
en: She was extremely beautiful, over 1.7 metres tall, with a graceful, well-proportioned figure, and she liked to dress up; now in her fifties she still retains her charm.

text: 俩人谈了半年结婚，一起出来实在赏心悦目。
en: The two dated for half a year then married; going out together they were truly a pleasure to behold.

text: 现在俩人儿子在国外留学，听说毕业后应该回来。
en: Now their son is studying abroad; I hear he should come back after graduating.

text: 他家里绝对是男人说了算，家务完全不做不管，当大爷一样。
en: In his home he absolutely calls the shots; he does none of the housework and takes no part in it, living like a lord.

text: 俩孩子都归老婆操心（他自己父母在外地，有兄弟照顾，不需他特别照顾），情绪价值没有，会在聚会时发现老婆哪里做的不合心意指着老婆鼻子骂。
en: Both children were left for the wife to look after (his own parents are out of town, cared for by his brothers, so he needn't specially tend to them); he provided no emotional value, and at gatherings would point at his wife's face and scold her over anything that displeased him.

text: 工资完全上交给老婆管，但是支出他说了算。
en: His salary was handed entirely to his wife to manage, but he had the final say on spending.

text: 给岳父岳母买了同小区的房子，自家别墅和海南的房子俩老人随便住，大舅子小舅子的生计他关照。
en: He bought a flat in the same complex for his parents-in-law; the old couple could stay as they pleased in his own villa and his flat in Hainan, and he looked after the livelihoods of his wife's elder and younger brothers.

text: 女方性格绵软，对前妻的孩子无微不至，百依百顺，不敢说一个不字。
en: The woman has a soft, gentle nature; towards the ex-wife's child she was attentive to the last detail and utterly compliant, not daring to utter a single word of objection.

text: 男孩子高中住校，回家时间有限，后来留学，基本共同生活时间不多。
en: The boy boarded at school in high school, with limited time at home, and later studied abroad, so they spent little time actually living together.

text: 现在俩人都退休了，没事开车自驾，招呼老朋友打打牌，过着悠闲自在的生活。
en: Now both of them are retired; with time on their hands they drive off on road trips and call old friends round for cards, living a leisurely, carefree life.

text: 婚姻没啥对错，只看合适不合适，舒服不舒服。
en: Marriage has no right or wrong to it; it only comes down to whether it suits or not, whether it's comfortable or not.

text: 还有一对再婚的，也过的挺好。
en: There's another remarried couple who also get along quite well.

text: 女方比较熟悉，我老公的下属，比我们小几岁，现在也五十出头了。
en: The woman I know fairly well; she's a subordinate of my husband's, a few years younger than us, now just past fifty.

text: 当年也是一方诸侯吧，开疆辟土的非常能干。
en: In those days she was a power in her own sphere, blazing new trails and extremely capable.

text: 长得也可以，就比较精英那种气质。
en: She was good-looking too, with that elite sort of bearing.

text: 前夫也是同单位的，但长期外派，外面有人了，俩人就离了，男的算净身出户吧，儿子那时初中，归她，房子车子也都归她。
en: Her ex-husband was also at the same unit, but was posted away long-term and took up with someone else, so the two divorced; the man basically left with nothing, their son was in junior high then and went to her, and the flat and car also went to her.

text: 后来孩子出国留学，费用前夫也负担了一半，现在孩子定居漂亮国了。
en: Later the child studied abroad, and the ex-husband covered half the costs; now the child has settled in America.

text: 娘家是当地的，孩子就在姥姥家吃住了两三年，大事小情的哥嫂也关照的好，生活不需要她操心，过的悠闲自在。
en: Her natal family was local; the child ate and stayed at the maternal grandmother's home for two or three years, and her elder brother and his wife looked after all the big and small matters well, so she had no need to worry about daily life and lived at her leisure.

text: 然后遇到现任，现任是兄弟单位的中层，比她大五六岁，大肚腩，但是才子，口才一流，参看胖子时代的矮大紧。
en: Then she met her current husband, a mid-level manager at a sister unit, five or six years older than her, with a sizeable paunch, but a gifted talent and first-rate speaker — think Gao Xiaosong in his portly days.

text: 离异，有一子，跟她儿子同龄。
en: Divorced, with a son the same age as her own.

text: 俩人挺浪漫…
en: The two of them were quite romantic…

text: 海边相依看月亮，落雪时跑山里看山舞银蛇，送花啥的不在话下，更厉害的是这男的做的一手好菜，征服了她的胃，羡慕死我了，聚会时我老公他们每次都一起上把这死胖子喝懵。
en: They leaned on each other watching the moon by the sea; when snow fell they'd run to the hills to watch the mountains dance like silver serpents; sending flowers and such was nothing to him, but what was even more impressive was that this man was a superb cook who conquered her stomach — I was green with envy; at gatherings my husband and the others would all pile in and drink this fatso into a stupor every single time.

text: 这些都是这男的自己喝多了说的，也是活该挨灌。
en: All of this was said by the man himself when he was drunk, and he thoroughly deserved to be plied with drink.

text: 俩人现在结婚也快十年了，男的婚后不久跳槽到北京——赚钱多点，儿子留学费用要负担。
en: The two have now been married nearly ten years; not long after the wedding the man changed jobs and moved to Beijing — to earn a bit more, since he had to cover their son's study-abroad expenses.

text: 婚后这男的住女方的房子里，他自己也有房子，但女方嫌弃不舒服，就这么住着了。
en: After the marriage this man lived in the woman's flat; he had his own place too, but the woman found it uncomfortable, so that's where they ended up living.

text: 过几年退休她去北京夫妻团聚，然后再男的退休一起回来。
en: In a few years, when she retires, she'll go to Beijing to be reunited with her husband, and then when he retires they'll come back together.

text: 俩人收入女的略高，到北京后男方收入上来了，但负担重点。
en: The two earn slightly more on her side; after the move to Beijing the man's income rose, but his burden is the heavier one.

text: 还是那句话，俩人觉得舒服就好。
en: As the old saying goes, as long as the two of them feel comfortable, that's all that matters.
